objective: Profile the original SGLang R201 B deployment with only the two paired-evidence indexer candidates integrated: R246 runtime row-stride score and R210 query-parallel indexer/caller. No formal request, no optimization beyond those two points, no A resources.

candidate_delta.base: R238 B original path and original C5 image
candidate_delta.score: R246 runtime row-stride four-declaration change installed as flash_kpool_score.py
candidate_delta.query_parallel: R210 generic query_parallel_indexer, row split inside the current native attention TP group
candidate_delta.caller: R210 caller; diff against the R238 caller adds only the row-split call site

capture.window_proof: Every captured forward must carry host scheduler metadata: forward index, query tokens, per-request context start/end, active requests, TP rank. Two consecutive captured forwards per window, all request contexts inside [lo,hi], query-token continuity. Otherwise the window is INVALID, not retried.
capture.arming: Controller writes /B/profile-B/ARMED only after service-ready and 0 running/waiting queues; observer ignores every earlier forward.
capture.device_time_source: Outer r234_capture_window marker, started after a device drain and stopped only after torch.npu.synchronize; native kernel_details.csv Start Time(us)/Duration(us) provide device-side intervals. CPU enqueue/instruction spans are never attributed to a device forward.
capture.control_tasks: Native WAIT, NOTIFY and SQE tasks are runtime control, not compute. They are excluded from compute unions and category shares and recorded only in a separate control-task bucket.
capture.profiler_info: Native info files are matched as profiler_info*.json, including profiler_info_0.json. An exact-name-only lookup is invalid.
capture.export_completeness: Each window must export profiler_info*.json, kernel_details.csv, operator_details.csv, step_trace_time.csv and trace_view.json; forward metadata and observer status must also be present. A CANN export/collection timeout or a missing product makes the run FAIL, never an empty PASS.
capture.window_elapsed_boundary: One outer CPU capture annotation surrounds two real native forwards and closes after torch.npu.synchronize; previous device work is drained before native profiler start. Category shares use the complete drained capture elapsed, never CPU execute_model duration.

framework.P_topology: TP16 DP1 EP1 eager, MTP off, chunked-prefill-size/max-prefill-tokens 4096, mamba radix extra_buffer
framework.D_topology: TP16 DP1 EP1 eager, MTP off, native chunk cache
framework.profiler_source: native SchedulerProfilerManager SHA a962ab82... from checks/r200-native-profile-source; scheduler overlay SHA bf67744c...
framework.request_legs: Decode POST submitted first, then Prefill POST; both max_tokens=1 per prefix
framework.native_batch_shape: mostly one prefill row (551/582 original cold batches)

sdma.data_plane: typed SDMA only; ASCEND_MF_TRANSFER_PROTOCOL=sdma; no RDMA fallback
sdma.byte_verify: FLASH_SDMA_VERIFY_BYTES=0 for the performance profile; config/source/log checks remain mandatory

resources.port_preflight: bind-check every exact port on the target node; verify no owned r247 container and no host-netns listener before start

r246_gate.live_idle: npu-smi on node46 and node47 must each report 8 'No running processes found' immediately before R247 staging
r246_gate.rule: R247 refuses to stage or start anything until main control signs the actual R246 PASS/idle8 receipt; a source hash alone never satisfies this gate.

budgets.idle_proof: 8x 'No running processes found' on both owned nodes
budgets.budget_policy: One 1200s absolute work budget covers B preflight/startup/requests/download/analysis. Cleanup preserves its independent safety fence. No automatic extension or experiment retry.

requests.profile_control_GET_POST: none; profiler is armed in-process by the observer

cleanup.rule: Stop P writer, prove container stopped and 8 idle NPUs, publish the writer-stop permit, then release the D destination stop. On timeout retain D destinations; never destroy them on an unproven writer.

per_forward: HCCL union and overlap with non-HCCL
categories: DSA indexer/score/topk, KDA, MoE grouped matmul, quant/dequant, attention, elementwise, layout, communication, control, unknown
analysis.control_task_policy: WAIT/NOTIFY/SQE are not compute; they are reported separately and excluded from core_compute_union_us and category shares.
analysis.cpu_policy: CPU enqueue and instruction spans are host-side only; per-forward device ownership is not inferred from CPU timestamps.
analysis.overlap_policy: never add overlapping kernel durations as critical-path share; per-category union is an upper bound, not a causal claim
analysis.export_policy: missing or timed-out CANN export => FAIL, not an empty COMPUTED result
analysis.raw_evidence: download operator_details.csv, kernel_details.csv, step_trace_time.csv, trace_view.json, profiler_info*.json, profiler_metadata.json, forward metadata and observer status within the byte cap; record every raw file path and SHA256 from the host profile index

claims.accepted_formal_baseline: R201 full warm 6403.1896 s remains the original B reference; no formal B acceptance is claimed
claims.r247_is_candidate_delta: The R247 B overlay has 47 files and is not byte-identical to the R238 original 46-file overlay.
claims.framework_gain: not claimed; this is one diagnostic whole-model profile
